claim: Blau and her colleague, Nidhi Bhutani, an associate professor of orthopedic surgery, discovered that in older mice, blocking 15‑PGDH reversed the cartilage loss that normally accompanies aging in the knee.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-06 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Stanford Medicine (27 Nov 2025), on the team's paper in Science: Bhutani is 'associate professor of orthopaedic surgery'; Blau a professor of microbiology and immunology. 15-PGDH roughly doubles in old mice's knee cartilage, and a small-molecule inhibitor (given systemically, then injected into the knee) thickened the age-thinned cartilage, which proved to be hyaline cartilage.
